title: XPress2 Tempest Grey Commuter + FREE Rear Rack, Fenders, Elite Headlight, Comfort Seat, Suspension Seat Post, Water-Resistant Pannier Bags ($459 Value)
body_html:
The Lectric XPress2 Commuter is designed to make every ride feel effortless. Building on the success of the original XPress, the XPress2 sporty commuter eBike introduces more power and smoother performance for riders looking to skip traffic and the rising cost of gas. Whether you're tackling hills, navigating city streets, or heading to work, the throttle is powerful enough to take over when you need a break, helping you arrive feeling ready for whatever the day brings your way.

Category-leading upgrades include an adjustable SR Suntour suspension fork, Star Union 602 hydraulic disc brakes, a Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetrain, and a large TFT color display. With fast charging capabilities and up to 60 miles of range, the XPress2 delivers real-world range you can trust and performance that holds up over time.

Combined with its comfort-focused geometry, reliable performance, and commuter-friendly design, the XPress2 brings a more elevated riding experience to everyday transportation and weekend adventures. Now there’s a smarter way to get around while helping you actually enjoy your commute.

title: FREE Large Rear Basket ($109 Value)
body_html:
From a cooler on a hot day to a pet carrier on a morning ride, the Large Basket is ideal for taking all of your favorite on-the-go items with you!

  • Steel encasing and hardware ensure extra stability.
  • Full compatibility with the Lectric standard and Premium Headlight.
  • Easy installation - basket is attached to the front or rear rack with just a few pieces of hardware, included in your purchase.

Compatibility:

  • Lectric XP™ (2.0 & 3.0)
  • Lectric XP™ Step-Thru (2.0 & 3.0)
  • Lectric XP™ Lite*
  • Lectric XPremium
  • Lectric XP™ Trike
  • Lectric XPedition
  • Lectric ONE*

 

*eBike models with an asterisk do not include a rear rack to mount a rear bakset, but can be purchased separately.

Note: The Front and/or Rear Rack is required to properly install the Large basket

Product Specifications: 

  • Large basket dimensions: 458mm x 310mm x 88mm

title: XP4 750 Limited-Edition Matte Forest - Ridge XPerience Kit
body_html:
The Lectric XP4 750 Limited-Edition Series takes America’s best-selling eBike and reimagines its legendary versatility around the way you actually ride. Each Limited-Edition eBike starts with the powerful, foldable XP4 750 and adds an exclusive matte finish paint job, plus a purpose-built XPerience Kit designed for a unique adventure.

You still get everything that makes the XP4 one of our most capable eBikes: a responsive torque sensor, powerful 750W motor, full-color TFT display, hydraulic brakes, a compact folding frame, speeds up to 28 mph, and up to 85 miles of range. What changes is how you make it yours—whether that means heading off the pavement, carrying more for the day, or simply riding with gear that better fits your routine. Same XP4. Reimagined for a different kind of life. Limited Edition. Available while supplies last.

title: XPress Lite Stratus White eBike
body_html:
Meet the Lectric XPress Lite, a lightweight commuter eBike built to make city riding easier, faster, and a lot more fun. Taking inspiration from the sleek styling riders love about the XPress family, the XPress Lite introduces an all-new mid-step frame that blends classic bike design with easy, approachable geometry—all in a lightweight package made for navigating busy streets, bike paths, and everyday trips around town.

Powered by a whisper-quiet 500W motor with speeds up to 28 mph, the XPress Lite makes quick work of commutes without weighing you down. Its slim, semi-integrated battery keeps the frame looking clean and provides up to 45 miles of range, while 27.5-inch slick tires and a lightweight aluminum fork create a nimble, efficient ride made for pavement.

And there’s plenty of performance packed into its sleek frame. The XPress Lite comes equipped with a Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetrain, hydraulic brakes, built-in turn signals, a thumb throttle, and Lectric’s XPerience Switch, allowing riders to choose between torque- and cadence-sensor riding. At an incredibly low price, it’s everything you need to leave traffic behind—and nothing you don’t.

title: Legacy Pet Trailer
body_html:
What could be better than a ride on your eBike? Bringing your four-legged co-pilot along for the journey. The Lectric Pet Trailer keeps your pet safe, comfy, and right by your side on every adventure.

  • Supports pets up to 50 lbs, making it a great fit for small to medium-sized companions.
  • Uses breathable mesh sidewalls paired with a waterproof polyester exterior for comfort in all conditions.
  • Features a zippable top opening and front window for easy access, airflow, and visibility.
  • Keeps your pet secure while giving them a clear view of the ride ahead.

title: Lazer Pnut KinetiCore 2.0 Toddlers' Helmet - Flying Rocket
body_html:
Lazer
Pnut KinetiCore 2.0 Helmet
Color: Flying Rocket
Size: One

Whether your youngest rider is traveling in a baby seat, cargo bike, or trailer, Pnut is designed to provide premium comfort and top-rated protection with kid-specific features to maximize your time outdoors together, stress-free.

  • Pnut KinetiCore is a feature-packed unisize helmet for kids ages 1 and up.
  • Next-level Protection: built-in KinetiCore technology offers additional protection from rotational impact in the event of a crash
  • No More Pinches: cheek buckle reduces the chance of painful skin pinching
  • Secure Fit: TurnSys fit system adjustment makes for quick, confident sizing with comfortable fit
  • More Coverage: helmet protects the sensitive temple area
  • Head circumference in CM: Unisize 46 - 52

 

Kid-Friendly Design

The Pnut KinetiCore is designed to help get your child geared up and ready to ride with ease. It features extra temple area protection, the TurnSys system for easy fit adjustment, and an easy-to-use no-pinch cheek buckle.

Easy adjustability

The Lazer TurnSys system with fixed head basket provides a tailored fit that’s easy to adjust on the move with a simple turn of the dial.

Sizing:

One size fits all from 46-52cm. The helmet shell and fit system are designed to accommodate a wide variety of head sizes and shapes, taking the guess work out of buying the right size helmet. 


Crashed? Get Your Helmet Replaced!

Your helmet’s job is to help protect your head in the event of a crash. Unfortunately, sometimes your helmet has to sacrifice itself in order to fulfill its mission. Lazer is happy to offer a 50% discount off a new replacement helmet so you can get back on your bike as soon as you are ready. Any Lazer helmet purchased within 3 years of crash damage is covered by the Lazer Crash Replacement Program.

Terms and conditions apply:

To make a claim, email help@lazersport.us with the subject line “Crash Replacement.” Please include:

  • Full name, address, date of purchase, photo of crash damage, model/size/color


Once received, a customer service representative will connect with you, providing a 50% off MSRP one-time use discount code. The code will be valid for a single helmet and is only valid for consumers in the United States.



Complies with U.S. CPSC Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets for Children Ages 1 and Up.

*Product information provided by Lazer

title: XP4 750 Pine Green eBike [CA]
body_html: The Lectric XP4 is the latest evolution of our XP model — a standout in the eBike industry trusted by more than 450,000 riders. Built for both fun and function, the highly anticipated XP4 continues the tradition of being a versatile, go-anywhere electric bike designed to fit your lifestyle. Packed with performance-focused upgrades, the XP4 maintains its convenient “travel-size” design, making it easy to fold, store, and transport wherever your ride takes you. Now featuring our in-house–designed torque sensor for smoother power delivery and a more natural riding experience, the XP4 also includes a fully redesigned frame, new colour options, a full-colour TFT display, and upgraded 602 hydraulic brakes. For riders seeking extended range and added performance, an optional upgraded 750W motor version paired with a 17.5Ah battery delivers up to 137 km of range on a single charge — so the adventure doesn’t have to end.

title: XP Trike2 750 Glacier Blue eTrike [CA]
body_html:
The Lectric XP Trike2 is freedom on three wheels, designed to accommodate a wide range of rider abilities and preferences with our lowest standover height ever at just 35 cm. Capable, comfortable, and fully foldable, the XP Trike2 is one of the best-selling electric trikes. Now available in six new colour options, the updated hydroformed frame has been redesigned with comfort and convenience in mind, featuring our new Cloud 50 suspension fork for a smoother ride, a 9-degree stem position for improved posture, and an adjusted seating position for added stability. This ride delivers big on fun while staying easy on the joints.

The XP Trike2 comes in two performance options, allowing you to choose how you want to ride. The 500W model is packed with upgrades and a refreshed frame design, all at the same great value. The 750W long-range model offers more power, extended range, increased hauling capability, and a torque sensor for a natural, intuitive ride feel.

title: Barrow Bar
body_html:
Give your XPedition2 passenger a better way to ride! The Barrow Bar adds a dedicated set of handlebars for extra comfort, control, and confidence—especially on longer rides. Designed to keep passengers supported while cruising right alongside you.

  • An ergonomic grab handle provides a comfortable, secure holding position for passenger riders.
  • Constructed from sturdy aluminum, the new design offers improved balance and stability, especially during turns.
  • Designed to pair perfectly with the Lectric Cushions and Running Boards for the ultimate passenger setup.
  • Quick and easy installation that securely attaches to the XPedition2 rear rack.

*Product Requirements

  • The Barrow Bar is recommended to be used with the Cushions and Running Boards (sold separately) when carrying passengers unless you are using Thule Yepp Maxi Child Seat(s).

Compatibility:

  • Lectric XPedition2

⚠️ Warning:
It is always the user’s responsibility to ensure the passenger and/or cargo loaded on the Lectric XPedition do not interfere or impact the user’s ability to safely operate the Lectric XPedition.
You MUST hold onto the Lectric XPedition whenever loading cargo and/or a passenger. The kickstand is not designed to be used for loading cargo. Do not assume the bike is stable and balanced when using the kickstand. Always hold onto the bike when cargo is being loaded, in place, or attached to the bike.
Please read the Lectric XPedition Manual for more information.

**A passenger incapable of riding a bike on their own should not ride as a passenger. Use your best judgment as a parent or guardian to keep a child or an adult passenger and the rider safe.

title: Small Pet Carrier
body_html:
Take your furry co-pilot on every adventure with this cozy, compact Small Pet Carrier designed to snugly fit in your eBike’s rear basket. With breathable mesh sides, a secure tether, and a padded base, it’s like first class for your small pet—just with more wind in their fur!

  • Perfectly sized for pets 20 lbs or less, giving small dogs and cats a safe, comfy ride wherever you go.
  • Dual-opening windows offer your pet plenty of fresh air and views while making it easy to load them in.
  • Two built-in safety leashes keep your pet secure on bumpy rides or sudden stops.
  • A waterproof base and removable mat make cleanup a breeze after muddy paws.
  • Sturdy, yet foldable design provides a stable ride for your pet and folds flat for easy storage.
  • Quick and simple to install—just place it in your rear eBike basket, strap it down, and you’re ready to roll.

Product Requirements:

  • The Small Pet Carrier is intended to be used with the Large Rear Basket (sold separately).

Compatibility:

  • Lectric XP (XP 2.0, XP 3.0, & XP4 Models)
  • Lectric XP Step-Thru (XP 2.0, XP 3.0, & XP4 Models)
  • Lectric XP Lite* (1, 2, & 3 Models)
  • Lectric XPremium
  • Lectric XP Trike (Model 1 & 2)
  • Lectric XPedition (1.0 & 2.0 Models)
  • Lectric ONE*

*eBike models with an asterisk do not include a rear rack to mount a Rear Basket, but can be purchased separately.

⚠️ Warning: It is always the user’s responsibility to ensure the passenger and/or cargo loaded on any Lectric eBike do not interfere or impact the user’s ability to safely operate the Lectric eBike.
Please read the Lectric Manuals for more information.

What's in the Box:

  • Pet Carrier Base
  • Pet Carrier Top
  • Base Mat
  • Quick-Release Leash Straps

Product Specifications:

  • 20 lb carry capacity 
  • Size: Small 
  • Fully Assembled Dimensions: 43.5cm length x 29cm width x 36cm height
  • Material: 500D/PVC + 600D ripstop/PU
  • Polyester Safety Leash

title: XPeak2 Step-Thru Long-Range - Black Friday Bundle
body_html: The XPeak 2.0 is a newly upgraded version of the trail-ready, all-terrain eBike. Tested to the most aggressive safety standards for off-road eBikes (eMTB), and named by Men's Health as a "Best of Sweat" winner in the 2025 Tech Awards, the XPeak 2.0 now comes standard with an industry-leading torque sensor that provides an exceptional riding experience with intuitive and controlled power delivery at each pedal stroke. Combined with the 750-watt Stealth M24 motor (1310 Peak) for a powerful yet hushed motor experience, the XPeak 2.0 delivers the muscle and speed to take on any terrain as a Class 1, 2, or 3 eBike. Additional upgrades include a newly designed hydroformed frame, a larger 203mm front disc brake rotor for maximum stopping power, an integrated color display, lock-on grips, and an 8-speed Shimano drivetrain.

title: Suspension Seat Post ($89 Value)
body_html:
Nothing will come as a shock with this epic upgrade! The Suspension Seat Post is one of our most popular accessories, featuring adjustable height and coil spring suspension for a smoother ride.

  • A coil spring suspension integrated into the seat delivers maximum shock absorption.
  • Easily adjusts to individual height with the latch of a seat clamp.
  • Thoughtfully designed as an upgrade to the XP™ 2.0 series. If you’re purchasing a Suspension Seat Post for any ebike other than Lectric, please refer to the product specifications to ensure a proper fit.

Compatibility:

  • Lectric XP™ Step-Thru 1.0
  • Lectric XP™ Step-Thru 2.0
  • Lectric XP™ Step-Thru 3.0
  • Lectric XP™ Trike
  • XPeak High-Step
  • XPeak Step-Thru

NOTE: The Suspension Seat Post for the XP™ Step-Thru 2.0 is a different length than the Suspension Seat Post for the XP™ 2.0. When inserting the seat post into the seat tube, the minimum seat height will be raised approximately 3” for both models. Please ensure the correct package is selected for your Lectric eBike model.

Product specifications:

  • XP™ Step-Thru 2.0 Suspension Seat Post length: 16” (400mm)
  • XP™ Step-Thru 2.0 Suspension Seat Post diameter: 1 1/4” (31.8mm)
  • Suspension: 40mm of travel
  • Engineered for riders up to 220 lbs.

 

Instructions:

  • Installation instructions for the Suspension Seat Post can be found here.

title: FREE Orbitor ($199 Value)
body_html:
Looking for a catch-all cargo solution? The Orbitor will keep small kiddos and hefty cargo loads in check while you're in motion! 

  • Sturdy aluminum material is durable and in it for the long run.
  • An inner railing bar allows kiddos to grab on safely and is X-tube wrapped for a comfortable, non-slip feel that protects against moisture.
  • Removable inner bars allow you to fit two 26-quart milk crates for even more storage capacity.
  • Included backrest cushion on rear vertical mount provides cargo support and offers extra comfort for passengers.
  • 6 accessory mounts allow you to customize your ride even more!
  • Use the Orbitor with Cushions, Running Boards, 2 Yepp Child Seats, XL Pannier Bags, Cargo Net, Cargo Straps, & more!

    *Product Requirements:

    • The Orbitor is recommended to be used with the Cushions and Running Boards (sold separately) when carrying passengers.

    Compatibility:

    • Lectric XPedition 2.0 only

    ⚠️ Warning:
    It is always the user’s responsibility to ensure the passenger and/or cargo loaded on the Lectric XPedition do not interfere or impact the user’s ability to safely operate the Lectric XPedition.
    You MUST hold onto the Lectric XPedition whenever loading cargo and/or a passenger. The kickstand is not designed to be used for loading cargo. Do not assume the bike is stable and balanced when using the kickstand. Always hold onto the bike when cargo is being loaded, in place, or attached to the bike.
    Please read the     Lectric XPedition Manual for more information.

    **A passenger incapable of riding a bike on their own should not ride as a passenger. Use your best judgment as a parent or guardian to keep a child or an adult passenger and the rider safe.

    What's in the Box:

    • Orbitor Frame
    • (2) Inner grab bars
    • rear vertical mount
    • front vertical mount
    • Back Cushion
    • Mounting Hardware

    Product Specifications:

    • Material: 6000 Series Aluminum
    • Inner bars: 420mm apart, X-tube wrapped
    • Dimensions: 800mm length x 507mm width x 250mm height

title: Fast Charger
body_html:
*Compatibility:

  • Lectric XP4
  • Lectric XPedition2
  • Lectric XPeak2 
  • Lectric XP Trike2
  • Lectric XPress2
If you have any questions about compatibility, please don't hesitate to contact our support team at contact@lectricebikes.com or (602) 715-0907.

 

Experience the ultimate convenience with our fast charger, designed to power up your battery in a fraction of the time. Say goodbye to long wait times and get back to riding—faster, smarter, and more efficiently than ever before!

  • Charges batteries 150% faster!
  • This 5A Fast Charger utilizes a standard AC power cable that plugs into any household or garage 3-prong 120V wall socket. 
  • Compatible Lectric eBikes can be charged by simply inserting the plug into the battery port.
  • Fast Charger can recharge select Lectric batteries within 1 to 4 hours using 5A amperage. Simply remove the plug when the charger light turns green.
  • Each charger comes with built-in safeguards and will automatically turn off when charging is complete.

Note: This Battery Charger is specifically designed for select electric bicycles produced by Lectric eBikes.
Do not use this charger for any products not specified.
Reads Owners Manual before use and only use indoors. 

Product Specifications:

  • Input: 120V~60Hz 4.0A
  • Output: 54.6V – 5A
  • Junlei 3015 3-prong connector
  • Aluminum case

 


Charge time is dependent on battery amp-hours and state of charge.
Battery Charger may vary cosmetically.

title: Bern Hudson MIPS Helmet - Matte Sand
body_html:
Bern
Hudson MIPS Bike Helmet 
Color: Matte Sand


The Hudson is an award-winning helmet that delivers that Bern low-profile styling in a lid that meets the new NTA 8776 safety standard. Translation … this thing is rated up to 27mph, meaning you’re covered whether you’re hopping on an e-bike, a scooter, or any other juiced-up ride. More protection, less bulk, and added visibility with a snap (literally) using our integrated click-mount light. Call it micro-mobility, electro commuting or COMMON. SENSE. Stay out there with the helmet that keeps you looking good and feeling safe on your next e-whatever adventure.

  • Find your perfect fit with Bern’s compass fit system. Simply twist the dial to adjust to your custom fit, keeping your head snug and secure. Due to its light weight, this system will feel as if the helmet were custom made for your comfort.
  • Bern’s custom-integrated LED light is lightweight and easy to use. This light brings ~6.6 lumens, micro-USB rechargeable, lasts up to 10 hours, water resistance, and has three light settings (steady, flash, and pulse). Simply click in place and ride on. 
  • Multi-Directional Impact Protection System. Designed to protect against rotational violence to the brain caused by rotational impacts.
  • Use these U-lock compatible reinforced vents at the back of the helmet to keep your helmet secure when it’s not on your head.
  • While the standards address force sustained in direct impacts, the Mips component is tested to help reduce your brain’s internal rotational motion in an impact, the types of injuries that can lead to concussions. During an impact, the Mips low friction layer allows the helmet to slide 10-15 millimeters in all directions, reducing some of the rotational motion to the brain vs. helmets without Mips.

Product Specifications:

  • Complies with U.S. CPSC Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets for Persons Age 5 and Older
    EN1078
    NTA8776
  • Construction: In Mold
  • Fit System: Compass Fit
  • Vents: 13
  • Light Features: 6.6 Lumens, Micro USB Rechargeable, 3 Light Modes (Steady, Flash, & Pulse), Lasts up to 10 hours, Water resistant
  • Avg. Weight: 370 grams.

Sizing:

To find your perfect fit, you'll need a measuring tape and your head. 
Measure around your head (in centimeters), taking the measuring tape just above the ears and about an inch above the brow line. 
Use your measurements and the size chart below to figure out which helmet size is best for you!

Small:  52 - 55.5cm, Hat Size: 6 1/2 - 7

Medium: 55.5 - 59cm, Hat Size: 7 - 7 3/8

Large: 59 - 61.5cm, Hat Size: 7 3/8 - 7 7/8

 

Product information provided by Bern

title: Thousand Chapter MIPS Helmet - Lectric Black
body_html:
Thousand
Chapter MIPS Helmet
Color: Lectric Black
Size: One Size Fits All


Engineered for performance, the Thousand Chapter Collection integrates elevated utility into your daily riding uniform to always keep you moving forward.

  • Add an extra layer of protection with the integrated Mips safety system, designed to reduce the rotational motion of certain impacts that may otherwise be transferred to your head.
  • Reduce glare and increase your field of vision with visors in elevated finishes.
  • Secret poplock: The most convenient and secure way to leave your helmet behind. Access the hidden channel behind the logo mark, and thread your U-lock or chain lock through. Backed by Thousand's Anti-Theft Guarantee.*
  • 8 strategically placed vents actively capture airflow and pass it through the interior cooling channels – developed to keep you cool on your long rides.

Product Specifications:

  • Integrated Mips Safety System for added protection against rotational forces.
  • Visors in premium finishes to increase your field of vision.
  • Secret Poplock for securing your bike helmet with your lock*.
  • Integrated dial fit system for precise adjustments.
  • One-handed magnetic fastener and nylon straps.
  • Active ventilation with 8 vents and internal channeling.
  • Lightweight helmet at 370g (M).
  • Complies with U.S CPSC Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets for Persons Age 5 and Older.
  • Certified for CE and CPSC standards for cycling.

Sizing:

It is important to find the right size helmet for optimal safety.

First, you need to find a measuring tool, ideally using a flexible measuring tape or a phone charger (and a ruler to measure against it). Next, Measure the circumference at the level of your forehead, approximately 1 cm above your eyebrows. Lastly, find your size using the measurements below.

One Size Fits All (Medium): 22 3/8'' - 23 1/4'', 54.5-60 cm, Hat Size: 6 3/4 - 7 4/8

Fit Notes: Every head is different, but with our helmets' integrated dial fit system, it's easy to make small adjustments for a comfortable fit. Just turn the dial clockwise to tighten or counterclockwise to loosen. You can also remove some or all of the interior fit pads without affecting the safety of your lid to accomplish your preferred fit. 


WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm - www.P65Warnings.ca.gov

 

*PopLock is not compatible with Lectric eBikes folding Bike Lock but is compatible with our Bottle Shaped Bike Lock.

Product information provided by Thousand

Weighing in at just 49 pounds, the foldable XP Lite is ready to tackle everything from trips into town to exciting joyrides with a Lectrifying twist of the throttle. A Gates Carbon Drive Belt system provides nearly maintenance-free functionality! On top of that, enjoy hydraulic brakes, Lectric PWR programming, an LCD color display, and much more. The XP Lite 2.0 also includes an option to add a long-range battery.

title: FREE Bike Lock ($59 Value)
body_html:
Looking for a compact lock for your compact bike? Protect your ride with the foldable and mountable Bike Lock!

  • The Bike Lock is compatible with any ride, but specifically designed for easy storage on Lectric eBikes.
  • Simply bolt the lock mount to the side of the seat tube facing the rear fender of your Lectric eBike, then insert the folded lock in the mount and you’re ready to roll!
  • Own a different style of ebike? You can strap the lock to your frame, making it a convenient security measure. 

NOTE: Bolts and insertion points for the Bike Lock come on all Lectric eBikes and are found on the seat tube facing the rear fender. 

Compatibility:

  • All Lectric eBike Models
  • Most standard bicycles or eBikes

Product Specifications:

  • Weight: 1.9 lbs. 
  • Lock dimensions: Approximately 34" when fully unfolded
  • Allen wrench included for easy installation

body_html:
Tannus
Armour Insert
Size: 27.5" x 1.95" - 2.5"

Tannus Armour is the ultimate in tire protection and performance for all levels and styles of riding. Sitting between your tire and inner tube, the Tannus Armour provides 15mm of puncture protection on the top, as well as 2mm of sidewall protection from sharp objects and rocks. Whether you are a city biker, adventure tourer or prefer the off-road, downhill or gravel trails, Tannus Armour gives you increased grip and vibration dampening for a smoother, more comfortable and enjoyable ride.

Tannus Armour protects your tube against 90% of common bike flats using 15mm of multi-cell foam. Say goodbye to pinch and puncture flats.

  • Patented Aither Technology; Aither is a multi-cell foam compound that forms the structure of the Armour
  • Sitting between your tire and inner tube, Tannus Armour provides 15mm of puncture protection under tread, and 2mm of sidewall protection from sharp objects and rocks
  • Eliminates 90% of all punctures due to its reinforced sidewall and underside protection
  • Run at lower pressures for increased grip in wet conditions and loose rock
  • Absorbs vibrations for a smoother, more comfortable ride
  • Engineered to minimize rolling resistance (drag), Tannus Armour provides the ultimate balance of speed and protection
  • Installation is as quick and easy as installing a regular tire and is maintenance-free

title: Lazer Nutz KinetiCore Kids' Helmet - Black
body_html:
Lazer
Nutz KinetiCore Helmet
Color: Black
Size: One

Thoughtfully designed so you can spend more time adventuring with your child and less time fiddling with gear, the unisize Nutz KinetiCore helmet provides confidence-inspiring protection for little ones graduating to balance bikes or first pedal bikes.

  • Nutz KinetiCore is a feature-packed unisize helmet for kids.
  • Built-in KinetiCore technology offers additional protection from rotational impact in the event of a crash.
  • Skip the chin-pinching drama with a child-friendly side buckle that lays flat against the cheek.
  • EZ Fit system automatically adjusts helmet from 50-56cm.
  • Helmet protects the sensitive temple area.
  • Product Weight: 250g
  • A built-in insect net keeps bugs out while letting the breeze in, minimizing distractions and irritations.

Sizing:

One size fits all from 50-56cm. The helmet shell and fit system are designed to accommodate a wide variety of head sizes and shapes, taking the guess work out of buying the right size helmet. 

No-fuss Automatic EZ Fit system makes finding a secure fit effortless. Just open it, put the helmet on, and it’ll automatically adjust to provide the right fit for your child.


Crashed? Get Your Helmet Replaced!

Your helmet’s job is to help protect your head in the event of a crash. Unfortunately, sometimes your helmet has to sacrifice itself in order to fulfill its mission. Lazer is happy to offer a 50% discount off a new replacement helmet so you can get back on your bike as soon as you are ready. Any Lazer helmet purchased within 3 years of crash damage is covered by the Lazer Crash Replacement Program.

Terms and conditions apply:

To make a claim, email help@lazersport.us with the subject line “Crash Replacement.” Please include:

  • Full name, address, date of purchase, photo of crash damage, model/size/color


Once received, a customer service representative will connect with you, providing a 50% off MSRP one-time use discount code. The code will be valid for a single helmet and is only valid for consumers in the United States.



Complies with U.S. CPSC Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets for Children Ages 5 and Up.

*Product information provided by Lazer

body_html:
Tannus
Armour Insert
Size: 20" x 3.0" - 4.0"

Tannus Armour is the ultimate in tire protection and performance for all levels and styles of riding. Sitting between your tire and inner tube, the Tannus Armour provides 15mm of puncture protection on the top, as well as 2mm of sidewall protection from sharp objects and rocks. Whether you are a city biker, adventure tourer or prefer the off-road, downhill or gravel trails, Tannus Armour gives you increased grip and vibration dampening for a smoother, more comfortable and enjoyable ride.

Tannus Armour protects your tube against 90% of common bike flats using 15mm of multi-cell foam. Say goodbye to pinch and puncture flats.

  • Patented Aither Technology; Aither is a multi-cell foam compound that forms the structure of the Armour
  • Sitting between your tire and inner tube, Tannus Armour provides 15mm of puncture protection under tread, and 2mm of sidewall protection from sharp objects and rocks
  • Eliminates 90% of all punctures due to its reinforced sidewall and underside protection
  • Run at lower pressures for increased grip in wet conditions and loose rock
  • Absorbs vibrations for a smoother, more comfortable ride
  • Engineered to minimize rolling-resistance (drag), Tannus Armour provides the ultimate balance of speed and protection
  • Installation is as quick and easy as installing a regular tire and is maintenance free

Compatibility: 

  • Lectric XP (XP 1.0, XP 2.0, XP 3.0, & XP4 Models)

  • Lectric XPedition 1.0
  • Most standard bicycles or eBikes with 20" x 3.0" - 4.0" tires

title: Lazer Codax KinetiCore Helmet - Matte White
body_html:
Lazer
Codax KinetiCore Helmet
Color: Matte White
Size: One


Whether you’re cruising around the city or heading out onto gravel roads, the Codax KinetiCore features a comfort-centric design made for the everyday cyclist seeking versatile performance. A fully integrated visor blocks the sun from getting in your eyes, while netting on the front vents keeps insects out. With the quick and easy TurnSys system delivering precise adjustability, all it takes is a quick spin of the dial for a perfect fit in seconds.

  • Adult Bike Helmet: the Codax KinetiCore is a sporty all-around cycling
  • Next-level Technology: built-in KinetiCore offers additional protection from rotational impact in the event of a crash
  • LED Light Compatible: made for use with the Universal Lazer LED light to increase visibility in all light and weather conditions
  • Easily Adjustable: TurnSys system provides a secure fit instantly
  • Guaranteed Fit: one size fits all from 54-61cm
  • Product Weight: 270g


Sizing:

One size fits all from 54-61cm. The helmet shell and fit system are designed to accommodate a wide variety of head sizes and shapes, taking the guess work out of buying the right size helmet. Simply turn the helmet’s integrated TS+ fit adjustment dial clockwise to tighten or counterclockwise to loosen. The rear head basket is also adjustable up and down to further customize the fit. Detailed information regarding fit adjustment can be found in our fitment video.

Crashed? Get Your Helmet Replaced!

Your helmet’s job is to help protect your head in the event of a crash. Unfortunately sometimes your helmet has to sacrifice itself in order to fulfill its mission. Lazer is happy to offer a 50% discount off a new replacement helmet so you can get back on your bike as soon as you are ready. Any Lazer helmet purchased within 3 years of crash damage is covered by the Lazer Crash Replacement Program.

Terms and conditions apply:

To make a claim, email help@lazersport.us with the subject line “Crash Replacement.” Please include:

  • Full name, address, date of purchase, photo of crash damage, model/size/color


Once received, a customer service representative will connect with you, providing a 50% off MSRP one-time use discount code. The code will be valid for a single helmet and is only valid for consumers in the United States.

 


Complies with U.S. CPSC Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets for Persons Age 5 and Older.

*Product information provided by Lazer

title: Hollywood Racks - Sport Rider eBike Hitch Rack
body_html:
The Sport Rider Bike Rack for Electric Bikes is our hitch bike rack designed specifically to carry electric bikes with any sized tire up to 5" wide. This bike rack can carry up to 2 electric bikes or standard bikes. If you're looking for an e-bike rack that works with bikes with fenders, look no further than the Sport Rider SE for Electric Bikes. 

This durable, strong bike rack includes new universal extra heavy-duty wheel holders for heavy load carrying capacity. As with the Sport Rider SE, this hitch-mounted bike rack can fold flat against the car when not in use and can be tilted for easy access to the cargo area. Also includes a keyed-alike locking hitch pin, 8' security cable, and locking frame to keep your rack and bikes secure during travel. Features patented No Wobble-No Tools Hitch Tightening System. For 2" hitches only.

*Step-Thru Frame Requirements:

Lectric eBike models with a low stand-over height, or Step-Thru frames, require an adjustable adapter bar in order to mount onto the Hollywood Rack.
The Lectric XPedition, XP Step-Thru, XPeak Step-Thru, XPress Step-Thru, & XPremium have Step-Thru frame designs and need the Rack Adapter Bar (sold separately) for proper use with the Sport Rider eBike Hitch Rack.

Compatibility:

  • All Lectric eBike Models* (Trike adaptor kit sold separately) 
    • Most standard bicycles or eBikes

    Product Specifications:

    • Class B RV only
    • Not to be used on any Class A, Class C, travel trailer, fifth wheel, or towed vehicle. 
    • Capacity: Two Bikes (Max. 80 lbs per bike)
    • Hitch Size: 2” only (Do not use a 1 ¼” -2” hitch adapter)
    • Maximum bike wheelbase: 60”
    • Minimum wheelbase: 36"
    • Maximum tire width: 5”
    • Features extra heavy duty wheel holders (Now with ratchet straps and rim protectors), an internally reinforced frame, and an external brace for heavy load carrying capacity
    • Includes keyed-alike locking hitch pin, 8’ security cable, and locking frame hooks
    • Patented “No-Wobble Hitch System" eliminates slack between the receiver and the rack without the use of tools
    • Folds flat against car when not in use
    • Tilts down for easy cargo door access
    • Space between bikes: 10
    • Now includes two Small Wheel Adapter (SW-ADP-U) for 20" Fat tire bikes rear wheels to prevent derailleur hanger interference (You will only need one per bike)
    • For step-through bicycles you will need to also purchase a Bike Adapter
    • Now includes a red safety strap to help secure the bikes to the central post and to each other
    • Rack Weight: 58 lbs.
    • Limited Lifetime Warranty
    • Not to be used on front hitches
